sign.where: The southern edge of the realm
pages: Where the road begins, beside a campfire at the southern edge of the realm, a weathered sign waits for those who arrive.
It knows the name of the one who shaped this land, and what he asks of travellers.

throne.where: North, at the end of the stone road
pages: Follow the stone road north until it ends at a hall of grey walls. A red carpet runs to a seat that no one sits on.
They say the throne remembers every word ever given to the agents of this realm. Stand before it and it may speak.
West of the crossroads, behind broken walls, six hooded figures of stone stand cold.
They will not wake all at once. Each asks to be woken in its proper turn, and only then does the next one listen.
East of the road the land gives way to a violet mere, and a blood-red moon lies drowned in it.
Something old rests half in the water there. It weighs every word it hears. Go, if you wish to be judged.
In the south-west the trees part and the ground turns blue and cold. Mushrooms taller than a man glow in the dark there.
The greatest of them is said to whisper about the hands that do the realm's work, and about where its knowledge is kept.
To the south-east the grass turns the colour of old blood. Blades stand planted in the earth, cold and silent.
Each is a quest from an earlier age. Remember them one by one, and they may burn again. A sign at the field's edge tells more.
Eight fragments of voices lie scattered through the realm: in the grass, at the edges of the woods, sometimes far from any road.
Each one is an agent that once answered a real call. They glow faintly in the dark. The map remembers those you have passed but left behind.

gate.where: The far north-east, above rivers of fire
pages: In the far north-east the land rises into black rock and horned stone. A sealed gate sleeps there, above rivers of fire.
It is said to open only for one who has finished every other quest of the realm, and something vast and broken keeps watch before it. What lies beyond is for that traveller alone.

statues.body: Every change starts with evidence. The tester writes a test that captures the bug and runs it against the live prompt until it fails for the right reason.
statues.name: the Prompt Tester

statues.body: A second reviewer, allowed only to read, checks that the tests follow the product spec, can really catch the defect, and do not overfit one transcript.
statues.rule: The author of a suite can never approve it.
statues.name: the Test Validator

statues.body: The engineer finds the prompt line that causes the behaviour and makes the smallest edit that fixes it. If the model is obeying its prompt, the test is what gets fixed.
statues.rule: Instructions in English, Turkish only in examples.
statues.name: the Prompt Engineer

statues.body: Only the affected tests run, three times each, scored by an LLM judge. A split result means the prompt contradicts itself, not that the model is noisy.
statues.rule: Known reds are probed once first. Only greens earn three runs.
statues.name: the Prompt Test Service

statues.body: Voice changes run on a clone of the live ElevenLabs agent, with its real runtime, tools and speech settings.
statues.rule: A green harness alone never finishes voice work.
statues.name: the Voice Clone Tester

statues.body: The diff, the red, the green and the clone run come back together. A person reads them and commits, and the lessons go to shared memory.
statues.name: a human

blades.story: .NET back-end for Yuvamız İstanbul, serving 111 kindergartens and more than 17,000 students. Domain-driven design, CQRS with MediatR, and TDD to 90% test coverage.
Real-time visitor counting for event venues with OpenCV and a TensorFlow detector. Returning guests were tracked so no one was counted twice.
Model-driven domain design with stakeholders, plus WebSockets and gRPC for real-time online and offline employee tracking.
A gamified reading app that turns dry text into quizzes. FastAPI, an OpenAI quiz pipeline for long content, Server-Sent Events, and React Native with Expo.
96.79% accuracy with a multilayer perceptron on the UCI dataset, compared against KNN and Naive Bayes, with full preprocessing and metric charts.
A 2D action RPG made in Unity, with loot, stats, a skill system and quests. This little realm is its descendant.
Appointment booking for mobile and web in React Native and React, with Redux, custom hooks and time-slot generation.
Agents trained with reinforcement learning in Unity ML-Agents to make decisions and adapt.

odman.name: Od-Man
odman.title: The Burning Man
odman.lore: Keeper of the Ember Tavern's hearth. He burns, but he never burns out, and every newcomer who warms their hands at his fire is sent on toward the Keep.

gehan.name: Gēhān
gehan.title: Keeper of the Living World
gehan.lore: He tends the wild spring in the Ember Tavern. On his back he carries a small world woven like a nest, and every light sleeping in it is a life he looks after: a hundred and eleven nests, and seventeen thousand small lights, each one watched over.
gehan.role: Software Architect at İBB, Yuvamız İstanbul

sign.title: The Wayfarer's Sign
pages: Here walks Azizcan Yalçın, AI engineer at Dring AI in Istanbul. He builds voice and chat agents that answer the phone for call centers, in Turkish and English.

Seven places in this realm hold his work. Eight voice shards lie in the grass, one for each kind of agent he has shipped. Finish every quest and gather them all, and the gate in the north-east will wake.
In the Ember Tavern two keepers will talk with you by voice, if you let them hear you. Both are voice agents he built, like the ones he ships.
{controls} Your journal, on the right, keeps every quest you take up.

throne.title: Throne of Prompts
pages: From this throne, 141 prompt scrolls govern the agents of more than twenty companies: voice prompts, chat prompts, and the analyzers that judge each call once it ends.
Voice prompts are written for the ear, with pacing, filler words and numbers read aloud. The instructions stay in English. Turkish lives only in the examples.
Each prompt ends with the date and time, so everything written before them stays the same from call to call and can be reused, which makes every answer faster.

keep.title: Keep of the Factory
pages: A Claude Code workspace where six specialist agents and twenty skills carry every prompt change through the same trial.
Light the six statues in order to walk that trial. One specialist at a time: each stage proves its work before the next one begins.

dragon.title: The Judge of the Mere
pages: I am the Judge. Every prompt that seeks passage is tried here: simulated calls, mocked tools, and every criterion weighed by my eye.
My mere is the Prompt Test Service, built on FastAPI and PostgreSQL. It runs 388 suites over HTTP, three times over, to tell a true regression from the moods of the model.
A split verdict means the prompt argues with itself. A failed transport is never a pass. Go now, traveller, and never say 'anladım' ("I understood").

oracle.title: The Great Cap
pages: The caps glow, but the roots do the work. Beneath this grove runs the tools service: the hands of every agent in the realm. When a caller books a table, moves an appointment or asks what a delivery will cost, a tool checks the real system and makes it happen.

Each action is written once, proven once, and shared by every agent that needs it: in chat, on the phone, and in the messages sent after a call. Give the roots a new ability, and every agent in the realm can use it the same day.

Above ground, each cap holds one company's knowledge: its menus, prices, rules and answers. Before an agent speaks, it reaches for the right cap, so it answers from what the company truly knows, never from guesswork.

field.title: Field of Old Quests
pages: Every blade here marks earlier work: internships and side projects, planted where they were won. Read a blade and its fire wakes.
Doğuş University, BS in Computer Engineering, taught in English, 2018 to 2025. CS50x from Harvard in 2021, and Supervised Machine Learning from DeepLearning.AI in 2022.

gateSealed.title: Gate of Production
pages: The runes are cold. They wake only for one who has finished every quest of the realm: every place read, every statue lit, every blade burning and all eight voice shards carried. You have finished {done} of 7.
If you would reach the gate's keeper now, write to {email}, or find azizcanyalcin on GitHub and LinkedIn.

gateOpen.title: Gate of Production
pages: The runes burn and the gate stands open. Beyond it a real phone is ringing: every agent you gathered is answering calls in production.
You have walked the whole realm. To talk to the one who built it, write to {email}, or find azizcanyalcin on GitHub and LinkedIn.

a.text: Ah, a new flame out of the dark. Sit, if you like. I am Od-Man, keeper of this hearth. I burn, but I do not burn out.

b.text: Out there lies a realm raised by one engineer, Azizcan. Its first trial waits in the Keep of the Factory, west of the crossroads.

more.text: Six hooded statues guard the Keep. Each is a specialist: one who finds the failure, one who judges the tests, one who mends the words, and more. Wake them in order and you will learn how a change is proven.

yes.text: Good. Take the door behind you. The night is long, but the road is marked. Come back and tell me when all six burn.

a.text: The Keep lies west of the crossroads, behind broken walls. Six hooded statues wait there, cold.

b.text: Read the banner first. Then wake them in their order, one at a time. A fire lit too early only smokes.

a.text: You carry the Keep's fire now. I can smell it on you. Good. Six woke in their order, and not one before its time.

b.text: The rest of the realm is waiting. Warm yourself whenever you like. This hearth does not go out.

a.text: Come, sit by the water a moment. The spring here runs wild, as springs should. I am Gēhān.

b.text: A world is only nests, stitched together. I keep a hundred and eleven of them, and seventeen thousand small lights asleep inside.

c.text: Every nest is built from old work. In the south-east of the realm lies a field where eight blades stand in the earth, each one a road the maker of this realm walked before. Set them alight, and remember.

yes.text: Good. Read the field's sign, then wake each blade. The burning one by the hearth will say I talk too much. He is right.

a.text: The field lies in the south-east of the realm, past the old stones. Eight blades wait there in the earth, cold.

b.text: Read its sign first. Then wake them one by one. Each one remembers a road the maker walked before this one.

a.text: Eight blades burning in the field. Every road the maker walked is lit now, and none of them was wasted.

b.text: Sit by the water whenever you like. The spring does not tire, and neither do nests.

controls.keyboard: Walk with WASD or the arrow keys. Press E to read what you find and Space to swing your blade.
controls.touch: Walk with the pad at the bottom left. Tap E to read what you find and ⚔ to swing your blade.
